display_long_description:
Game Overview
Step into the role of a futuristic aerial explorer. Soar through advanced cities, challenge high-speed tracks, and dive into thrilling aerial combat!
Urban Dash is an immersive VR flight simulator that blends racing, combat, and open exploration—delivering a dynamic world where you’re free to fly, fight, and strategize.

 What’s New in This Update
· New Aircraft System Unlocked
·20 uniquely designed aircraft, each with its own distinct style
·Customizable attributes: Speed, Acceleration, Energy, Stealth, Alloy, and Lock-on Range
·Browse and select aircraft freely in the main menu—perfect for collectors and strategy lovers

 Combat Gameplay Now in Testing
·Real-time dogfights with dual-controller support: fly with one hand, aim and shoot with the other
·New shield mechanic: your defenses weaken under attack, and explode when shield hits zero
·Smarter AI enemies: some strike from a distance, others sneak up from behind—get ready for all-angle combat
 
New Map: Future New Delhi
·Soar above luxury towers or dive into gritty, street-level districts for a sharp visual contrast
·Choose between fast, high-altitude routes or immersive low-flying paths
·Layered, complex city design offers strategic freedom in how you fly

Multiplayer System Now Online!
·Invite friends into the same world to take on challenges or freely explore side by side.
·Fight together in the virtual realm and create unforgettable memories.

Update now and begin your brand-new multiplayer adventure!
